title: How the Ello hiring workflow moves through Clay
subtitle: Each row is a table. Follow the numbers left to right. Paid steps only run on rows that passed every step before them.

lanes.name: Businesses
lanes.note:
one row per business.
The main table.

steps.title: Find job posts
steps.text: Clay Find Jobs: Lagos, 30 days. Check fields, then 25 rows

steps.title: Free post checks
steps.text: Title, Lagos, date, recruiters. Match company. Calls or chat?

steps.title: Send each business once
steps.text: Deduped on Account Key, newest post wins

steps.title: Business gates
steps.text: 1 to 3 open roles, 50 staff or fewer if known, not in HubSpot

steps.title: Type and CAC (AI)
steps.text: Retail, food or salon? Role title, owner name. Registered with CAC?

steps.title: Route to a cell
steps.text: Business type x calls or chat = 12 cells. Unclear goes to review

steps.title: Find and check email
steps.text: Job description, then website (AI). Validate every one

steps.title: Copy, send, log
steps.text: 4 approved lines as formulas. Paused campaign, HubSpot log
